description: ODC: the life cycle of an ITimeOfDay agenda item of a timer (create, get, set, duplicate, move) with the Interval the platform uses on it: Any. The time of an ITimeOfDay is its Hour/Minute (the timer's Schedule writes them); Studio never changes its Interval. With AtOrOn/Every/Between the item is left without Values and the ordering that the Schedule redoes at each child created or changed (SortScheduleItemsComparer) fell into NullReferenceException as soon as there were two, with no op index (the phase 1 finding). The kernel now refuses that set with the explanation: tests/jobs-odc-negative/timeofday-interval-atoron.json.

ops._why: two Any items: the Schedule ordering compares them without touching Values
